errors.evidence: Execution logs: Please search for the USGS record on nonnative occurrences of the pet clownfish (the species popularized by the movie Finding Nemo) that were reported before the year 2020. I need to know the location details as given in the USGS Nonindigenous Aquatic Species Database, in particular the five‐digit zip codes of the reported sightings.
errors.description: The LLM attempted to delegate searching to a "search_agent" but instead only printed the task text inside a Python interpreter block and never invoked an actual search or web request. This indicates a selection of an inappropriate tool or failing to use the available tool correctly, resulting in no real data retrieval.

The system fabricated a final answer claiming the key West zip code 33040 was found in USGS data, with no evidence or actual retrieval from a credible source. It pretended to have received the information from the search_agent, creating a hallucinated tool output.

errors.evidence: Multiple consecutive calls to the python_interpreter tool issuing identical requests to the search_agent without progress or new information
errors.description: The system repeatedly invoked the same Python interpreter block to submit identical search queries, exhausting computational resources unnecessarily.
